_comment: Three recorded voices: a dry, close-mic'd narrator and two reverberant dialogue voices (a breathy, half-whispered one and a calm, fully voiced one). Narration + the scared, whispering voice (the one who says 'Rachel') = Glim; the calm reassurer = Rachel, his inner consciousness. Evidence and close calls in README.md (Speakers); numbers from analysis/voice_analysis.py.

cast.glim: Glim - a humanoid astral being with a starry body, a hole in his chest full of night and a chipped ring orbiting his head; saw the face of God and no longer looks up
cast.rachel: Rachel - Glim's inner consciousness: a pale, glowing, inside-out double that unspools from a third eye on his forehead and grins too wide

turns.at: I once saw the face of God
turns.speaker: glim

turns.at: No I mean at the window
turns.speaker: glim
